Droplets of a liquid called a coacervate, which form when oppositely charged molecules come together in water, have attracted attention as models for membraneless compartments inside cells and for "protocells," hypothetical primitive cells that may have preceded modern ones.

title: Koliko vas automobil zapravo košta? Stavili smo sve na papir i došli do iznosa koji bi vas mogao šokirati
summary: Koliko vas zapravo košta automobil? Većina vozača na to će pitanje gotovo automatski odgovoriti iznosom koji svakog mjeseca ostavlja na benzinskim postajama. Oni pedantniji pribrojit će registraciju, osiguranje i poneki servis. No kada se zbroji baš sve - od goriva, kaska i guma do parkiranja, nepredviđenih kvarova i gubitka vrijednosti - računica postaje znatno neugodnija. Jer automobil vas može stajati nekoliko tisuća eura godišnje čak i kada se ništa ozbiljno ne pokvari.

title: Scientists reveal how deadly Andes hantavirus attaches to human cells
summary: Earlier this year, an outbreak of Andes hantavirus on a cruise ship, which killed three passengers and sickened 13, highlighted the lack of approved vaccines or treatments for the virus. In a study published in Nature, scientists at Albert Einstein College of Medicine and collaborators from Institut Pasteur and LSU Health Shreveport show how the virus recognizes its target on a human cell, a finding that could lead to effective therapies against Andes virus and other hantaviruses.
